title: Persist a versioned Board document
summary: Mutating imported design truth directly would destroy provenance; storing only final coordinates would make undo, AI proposals and safe write-back difficult to audit. Introduce a separate Codable BoardDocument with schema version, stable object IDs, layers, source links and command-based operation history, while imported StudioNativeDocument remains read-only.
acceptance_criteria: A Codable BoardDocument owns schema version, pages, layers, objects, source metadata and document preferences independently from StudioNativeDocument.
Board files save atomically, reload byte-equivalent semantic state and preserve unknown optional fields or fail with a clear unsupported-version posture.
Schema migration tests cover the initial version plus one synthetic older fixture.
Operation history stores validated commands or transaction summaries needed for undo, proposal diff and attribution without serializing SwiftUI state.
Imported design truth is referenced, never copied into mutable source-owned fields without an explicit snapshot type.
Corrupt, newer-version and missing-asset documents produce distinct recovery states.
BoardCore tests, native build and repository checks pass.

evidence.note: StudioNativeDocument is an imported inspection projection.
Authoring intent must remain separate from exported truth.
Auditable proposal trails and later write-back are explicit future goals.

blocked_by.reason: Required Board foundation must be solved first.

trigger.source_ref: HumbleStudio Board architecture finding HS-BAR-003, requested by Jan.

commands: xcodebuild -project HumbleStudio.xcodeproj -scheme HumbleStudioMac -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
agent_notes: Board changes must remain proposal-first and must not mutate source truth unless a future separately accepted apply contract permits it.
Do not broaden this slice into real-time collaboration, arbitrary source rewrite or a provider-specific AI architecture.
Rejected alternative: Add mutable position fields to StudioNativeDocument — That mixes source truth with user-authored workspace state.
